module_title: State Legislature: Assembly and Council - Basic Understanding
introduction: Part VI of the Constitution (Articles 168 to 212) deals with the State Legislature. Just like the Parliament at the Centre, states have legislatures to make laws. Most states in India have a Unicameral system (only a Legislative Assembly), but a few large states have a Bicameral system (both an Assembly and a Council).

core_concepts.title: Legislative Assembly (Vidhan Sabha)
core_concepts.description: It is the 'Lower House' of the state. Its members (MLAs) are directly elected by the people. Its normal term is 5 years. The minimum age to become an MLA or Chief Minister is 25 years.

core_concepts.title: Legislative Council (Vidhan Parishad)
core_concepts.description: It is the 'Upper House' of the state. Its members (MLCs) are indirectly elected. Like the Rajya Sabha, it is a permanent body (cannot be dissolved), and its members serve a 6-year term. The minimum age is 30 years.

core_concepts.title: States with Bicameral Legislatures
core_concepts.description: Not all states have a Legislative Council. Currently, only 6 states have a bicameral legislature: Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, and Telangana.

important_entities.name: The Speaker
important_entities.description: Presides over the meetings of the Legislative Assembly and has the final authority to decide whether a bill is a Money Bill or not.

important_entities.name: The Governor
important_entities.description: Like the President at the Centre, the Governor is not a member of either house, but no bill can become a state law without their signature.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: Older textbooks might mention 7 states with Legislative Councils. Remember, after the reorganization of Jammu & Kashmir in 2019, its Legislative Council was abolished. There are only 6 now.

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: Karnataka, Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra, Bihar, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana. (A quick way to remember the 6 states with Legislative Councils).

exam_strategy_tips: Memorizing the names of the 6 bicameral states is crucial; this is a very frequent multiple-choice question.
Always remember the age limits: 25 years for MLA (Assembly) and 30 years for MLC (Council).
